# API review

<!-- Generated by scripts/api_review.py from the tool definitions. Do not edit by hand. -->

159 tools checked against [the API conventions](../api-conventions.md): 108 deviations, 60 to fix, 48 accepted.

## Findings of v0.6.0

| Finding | Decision |
|---|---|
| #146 validation errors as raw pydantic text | `INVALID_ARGUMENT` with the fields at fault and a hint listing the required parameters; `TOOLSET_DISABLED` for a tool of a disabled toolset. |
| #147 tools first called without their schema after gimp_enable_toolsets | the result lists each added tool with its required parameters and a one-line usage (ADR 0012). |
| #148 optional toolsets not discovered (WebP given up) | descriptions and `UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT` hints of default tools name the optional tool and toolset that cover the need. |
| #149 brightness -30 darkens by 7% | the description states the measured effect and points to gimp_exposure / gimp_levels for a predictable darkening. |
| #150 resize needs both dimensions | `width` or `height` alone keeps the aspect ratio, for images and layers. |
| #151 rotating an image takes 7 calls | gimp_rotate_image moves to the default `transform` toolset; to stay within the budget, GIMP undo groups (gimp_begin/end_undo_group, used by no evaluation task: agents use checkpoints) move from `history` to a new optional toolset `undo`. |
| #156 clone/heal repeat the source | `source` defaults to `item`; `source_offset: [dx, dy]` is the relative alternative to `source_x`/`source_y`. |
| #158 assigning built-in sRGB is a no-op | gimp_export_as takes `color_profile` like `png_options`; assigning `srgb` says it changes nothing. |
| #160 PNG exports write tIME | no `tIME` unless `png_options.metadata` contains `time`. |
| #161 metadata only localized | gimp_get_metadata also returns `raw`: each tag's untranslated value. |
| #162 recipes cannot use an earlier step's result | `{steps[N].id}` (and any top-level field) refers to step N's result, validated before anything runs. |
| #164 created objects named differently | a top-level `id` names the created or changed object (conventions, Results). |
| #165 TIFF writes one page per layer | gimp_export_as takes `layers: "flatten"` to write the visible composite as one page, without changing the image. |
| #173 EXIF orientation missing on Windows | investigated separately; no API change. |
